description: skipInstalls=false: npm 12 --package-lock-only refuses registry tarballs of packages with bundleDependencies (EALLOWREMOTE, npm/cli#9800); a full install does not. Remove once that issue is fixed. platformAutomerge=false: without branch protection, GitHub auto-merge would merge before the checks finish; Renovate merges itself only once every check (CI and the 7-day age) is green.

packageRules.description: Majors, and 0.x minors (Cargo and semver treat 0.x -> 0.y as breaking): one PR per dependency.
One PR of non-major updates per manager (cargo, npm, github-actions...). Patches, digests and pins of 0.x versions included.

sherpa-onnx links a prebuilt native archive: a bump needs the new archives' SHA-256 in packaging/sherpa-onnx.sha256 (CI fails closed until then), so it gets its own PR and is never merged by Renovate.
